title: Docs and design for kits, overlapping notes, reverse and ranges in DAW sets
description:
## Intent

Docs and design for M2.

## Steps

- `design/daw-set.md`: overlapping notes (the group and its numbered audio tracks), reverse, re-pitch, range overflow; mark rows built.
- `docs/concepts.md` "Taking a score into a DAW": kits as one clip per hit, overlapping notes, reverse, levels beyond range.
- `docs/glossary.md`: only if a new word appears. Never the vendor's name.

## Verification

the diff adds no mention of the vendor's name or the DAW's product name (the project's naming rule); docs render in the web app.

## Release

`docs(<this task's id>): kits, overlaps and reverse in DAW sets`.
